import math
import sys

EPS = 1e-9

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n > 11:
        print(0)
        return
    p = [[0]*5 for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(5):
            p[i][j] = int(next(it))
    
    delta = [[[0]*5 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    normSq = [[0.0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            for d in range(5):
                delta[i][j][d] = p[j][d] - p[i][d]
                normSq[i][j] += delta[i][j][d] * delta[i][j][d]
    
    ans = []
    for i in range(n):
        good = True
        for j in range(n):
            if j == i:
                continue
            for k in range(j+1, n):
                if k == i:
                    continue
                dot = 0
                for d in range(5):
                    dot += delta[i][j][d] * delta[i][k][d]
                # Avoid division by zero
                denom = math.sqrt(normSq[i][j]) * math.sqrt(normSq[i][k])
                if denom == 0:
                    continue
                angle = math.acos(dot / denom)
                if angle < math.pi / 2 - EPS:
                    good = False
                    break
            if not good:
                break
        if good:
            ans.append(i + 1)
    
    print(len(ans))
    for v in ans:
        print(v)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
